title: Cheesy Spinach Egg Toast
steps: Melt butter in a pan over medium heat and saute spinach until wilted.
Toast the bread slices in the pan alongside the spinach.
Crack eggs directly over the spinach and season with salt and pepper.
Top with cheese, cover with a lid until melted, and place onto toasted bread.

title: Fluffy Banana Pancakes
steps: In a mixing bowl, mash the ripe bananas thoroughly until smooth.
Whisk in the eggs and milk until well combined.
Gently fold in the flour until a smooth batter forms.
Melt butter on a skillet over medium heat and pour batter rounds.
Flip once bubbles appear on the surface and cook until golden brown.

title: Classic French Toast
steps: In a shallow bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and ground cinnamon.
Melt butter in a skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Dip bread slices into the egg custard mixture for a few seconds per side.
Place bread in the hot skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.

title: Simple Avocado Toast
steps: Toast bread slices until crisp and golden.
Cut and scoop the avocado into a bowl, mash with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
In a skillet, fry or poach the eggs with a drizzle of olive oil.
Spread the mashed avocado generously over warm toast and top with the cooked eggs.

title: Mediterranean Shakshuka
steps: Heat olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat.
Dice onions and bell peppers, adding them to the skillet to saute until soft.
Stir in diced tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until a rich sauce forms.
Make small wells in the simmering sauce and crack the eggs into each well.
Cover with a lid and cook on low heat until egg whites are set and yolks are runny.

title: Creamy Stovetop Oatmeal
steps: Add oats and milk to a small saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Remove from heat once thick and creamy, then stir in honey.
Pour into a bowl and top with fresh berries and a sprinkle of chia seeds.

title: Cheesy Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Fry bacon in a pan until crispy, then crumble into small pieces.
Scramble eggs in a small pat of butter until soft and fluffy.
Place a tortilla on a skillet, layer with shredded cheese, scrambled eggs, and bacon.
Fold the tortilla in half and cook on both sides until crispy and cheese is fully melted.

title: Crispy Homemade Hash Browns
steps: Grate the potatoes and finely mince the onions.
Squeeze out all excess moisture from the potatoes using a clean kitchen towel.
Heat equal parts butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Press potatoes into a flat layer, season with paprika, and fry without disturbing for 5-6 minutes.
Flip and fry the other side until deeply golden and crispy.

title: Classic Cheese Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs with a splash of milk and black pepper until frothy.
Melt butter in a non-stick frying pan over medium-low heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and gently swirl until the base starts setting.
Sprinkle shredded cheese across the center, fold one half over, and slide onto a plate.

title: Greek Yogurt Fruit Parfait
steps: Slice bananas and wash fresh berries.
Spoon a thick layer of Greek yogurt into a glass or mason jar.
Add a layer of sliced bananas and fresh berries.
Sprinkle a generous layer of crunchy granola and drizzle with honey.
Repeat layers and serve chilled immediately.

title: Tomato Garlic Pasta
steps: Boil pasta in salted water according to package directions until al dente.
In a separate skillet, heat olive oil and saute minced garlic until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer until they break down into a sauce.
Toss the cooked pasta into the sauce and garnish with fresh basil.

title: Quick Veggie Stir Fry
steps: Cook rice or use pre-cooked day-old rice.
Heat oil in a wok or pan over high heat.
Add sliced carrots and bell peppers; stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Drizzle soy sauce over the vegetables, stir well, and serve over hot rice.

title: Classic Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread and lightly rub with a cut clove of garlic.
Place bread butter-side down on a medium-low skillet.
Layer sliced cheddar cheese and thin tomato slices between the bread.
Grill both sides slowly until bread is toasted golden-brown and cheese is melted.

title: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat oil in a large wok over medium-high heat.
Crack in eggs and scramble vigorously into small curds.
Add cold cooked rice and toss continuously to separate grains.
Drizzle soy sauce over rice and stir in chopped green onions right before serving.

title: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Melt butter in a pot and saute minced garlic until aromatic.
Add chopped fresh tomatoes and simmer on medium heat for 15 minutes.
Puree the soup until silky smooth using an immersion blender.
Stir in heavy cream and fresh chopped basil, then simmer for 2 more minutes.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
steps: Rinse and drain canned chickpeas thoroughly.
Dice fresh cucumbers and ripe tomatoes into bite-sized cubes.
In a salad bowl, toss chickpeas, cucumbers, and tomatoes together.
Drizzle extra virgin olive oil and fresh lemon juice over the top, then mix well.

title: Fresh Caprese Sandwich
steps: Slice crusty artisan bread and lightly drizzle inside with olive oil.
Slice fresh mozzarella cheese and ripe tomatoes into even rounds.
Layer tomato slices, mozzarella, and whole basil leaves inside the bread.
Press lightly and serve fresh or toast slightly in a panini press.

title: Mushroom Fried Rice
steps: Slice mushrooms thinly and finely chop garlic cloves.
Heat oil in a skillet over high heat and saute garlic and mushrooms until browned.
Add pre-cooked cold rice into the pan and break up any clumps.
Splash with soy sauce, toss everything over high heat for 3 minutes, and serve hot.

title: New York Deli Tuna Salad Wrap
steps: Drain canned tuna and flake into a mixing bowl.
Finely dice celery ribs and add to the bowl.
Mix in creamy mayonnaise and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice until well coated.
Spoon tuna mixture into warm tortillas, wrap tightly, and slice diagonally.

title: Classic BLT Sandwich
steps: Fry bacon strips in a pan until crispy and drain on paper towels.
Lightly toast bread slices until golden brown.
Spread mayonnaise evenly across each toasted bread slice.
Layer crisp bacon, sliced ripe tomatoes, and fresh lettuce leaves to assemble.

title: Butter Garlic Chicken
steps: Season chicken breast pieces and sear in melted butter until golden on both sides.
Remove chicken and saute minced garlic in remaining butter until fragrant.
Pour in heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer.
Whisk in grated parmesan cheese until a smooth creamy sauce forms.
Return chicken to the pan and coat thoroughly in the rich sauce.

title: Baked Lemon Garlic Salmon
steps: Preheat oven to 400F (200C) and place salmon fillets on a baking sheet lined with foil.
Melt butter and mix with minced garlic, fresh lemon juice, and chopped parsley.
Pour butter garlic mixture over salmon fillets generously.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork.

title: Classic Ground Beef Tacos
steps: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, draining excess grease.
Warm tortillas on a dry skillet or in the oven for a few minutes.
Fill tortillas with seasoned ground beef.
Top generously with shredded cheddar cheese, fresh salsa, and a dollop of sour cream.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
steps: Cook pasta in a pot of boiling salted water until al dente, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Melt butter in a large skillet and saute minced garlic for 1 minute.
Add peeled shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Toss cooked pasta and a squeeze of fresh lemon into the skillet with shrimp.
Add a splash of pasta water to coat everything in a silky garlic butter glaze.

title: Honey Garlic Glazed Chicken
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add chicken thighs and sear for 5-6 minutes on each side until deeply browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together honey, soy sauce, and minced garlic.
Pour honey garlic mixture into the skillet with chicken and bring to a simmer.
Baste chicken continuously as sauce thickens into a glossy sticky glaze.

title: Creamy Macaroni and Cheese
steps: Boil macaroni pasta until al dente, then drain.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat, whisk in flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually pour in milk while whisking constantly until sauce thickens.
Remove from heat and fold in shredded cheddar cheese until completely melted and smooth.
Toss drained macaroni into the velvety cheese sauce and serve warm.

title: Crispy Garlic Roasted Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 400F (200C) and cut potatoes into bite-sized cubes.
Toss potatoes with olive oil, minced garlic, and chopped fresh rosemary.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet so they do not overlap.
Roast for 35-40 minutes until golden and crisp, turning halfway through.
Sprinkle freshly grated parmesan cheese over hot potatoes right out of the oven.

title: Sizzling Chicken Fajitas
steps: Slice chicken breast, bell peppers, and onions into thin strips.
Heat olive oil in a heavy cast-iron skillet over high heat.
Add chicken strips and sear for 4-5 minutes until cooked through.
Toss in sliced bell peppers and onions, cooking quickly for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Warm tortillas and serve filled with the sizzling fajita mixture.

title: Easy Teriyaki Chicken with Rice
steps: Steam rice and cook broccoli florets until tender-crisp.
Cut chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces and cook in a skillet until browned.
Pour teriyaki sauce over the chicken and simmer until glaze thickens and coats the meat.
Assemble bowls with warm rice, steamed broccoli, and glazed teriyaki chicken.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds before serving.

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Cook spaghetti in a pot of heavily salted water until al dente, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
In a wide skillet, gently heat olive oil and thinly sliced garlic over medium-low heat.
Cook garlic until pale golden, then add red pepper flakes.
Transfer cooked spaghetti into the oil with chopped parsley and a splash of reserved pasta water.
Toss vigorously for 1-2 minutes until an emulsified glossy sauce coats the pasta.
